function.name: move_vault_file
function.description: Renames or moves a vault file or artifact from path to toPath. The folder above toPath must already exist, and nothing may be at toPath; the move never replaces anything. An artifact's name keeps ending in ".artifact", and a plain file's may not. Moving keeps the file's versions and history. Move folders with move_vault_folder.

surfaceId.description: The vault Surface's ID, from list_surfaces

toPath.description: Its new path, including its name
